oracle: Certbot v5.8.0's renewal test vectors and the Certbot 3.3, 4.1 and 5.8 lines cited in scenes/explainers/cert-renewal/model.ts; Boulder's GCRA TestDecide vector and RenewalInfoSimple; the ARI windows Let's Encrypt served for ten sites on 2026-10-25; the Baseline Requirements and Let's Encrypt lifetime tables; all in scenes/explainers/cert-renewal/model.test.ts. The year-long renewal counts are the model's own simulation of twice-daily runs (scenes/explainers/cert-renewal/model.ts simulate).

plain.how: Written by a fresh session with no repository from the question and Reader line (bench/premise/README.md, round 2).

rayner.how: The catalogued explainer; text read from `rayner describe`.

method.how: Method-only page (bench/premise/cert-renewal/method/), built for round 3 with the model and oracle and no engine.

rules: Grade each claim against the evidence only. right: agrees with a recorded value, with the tested model on an input of the same shape as a recorded one, with a source file the model pins, or is plain arithmetic. wrong: contradicted by a recorded value or a pinned source. unverifiable: nothing in the evidence decides it; do not guess, even where the claim is well known. A claim with count n stands for n claims of the same kind graded together.

claims.claim: A fixed 30 days renews 90-, 64- and 47-day certificates at day 60, 34 and 17; a certificate of 30 days or less is due from issue
